verses.1: And in the seventh month, on the first day of that month, from the time of Kvar-Kodesh until then, you shall not perform any work. It will be a day of rest for you.
verses.2: And they made an offering to God, as a scent of fragrance. They used one fruit from each tree, seven ripe fruits in total.
verses.3: And from their offerings, there was a lot of grain in the air; three hundred and twenty grains for each two hundred grains for the altar.
verses.4: And one twentieth of that amount was for each of the seven beams.
verses.5: And one of those wicked dogs has sinned against you.
verses.6: And the offering of the new year, and its sacrifice; and the offering of the eternal year, and its sacrifice. They are offered as an aroma pleasing to Jehovah.
verses.7: And in the twentieth day of the seventh month, this will be a sacred day for you. You must set aside all your work and duties, and not do any of them.
verses.8: And you shall bring up a pleasing aroma to Jehovah. It should be the aroma of fine wheat from one barley grain. It should also be the aroma of young grain, seven full grains in total. This will be pleasing to you.
verses.9: And from their offerings, three hundred and twenty were given to the priests, and two hundred and twenty were given to the other priests.
verses.10: Thirty for one lamp, for the seven lamps.
verses.11: One wicked act is worse than the sins of those who commit adultery and engage in other immoral behaviors.
verses.12: And in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, from the time of Kvar-Kodesh, it shall be a day of rest for you. You shall not do any work. This will be a holiday for you, a day of celebration for Jehovah, for seven days.
verses.13: And you shall bring along with you a woman who has a sweet fragrance for Jehovah. It should be three dozen rams, two dozen goats, and fourteen young bulls. They must all be fresh and healthy.
verses.14: And from their offering, there was a portion of grain worth thirty-one hundred units per unit. For the first sheep, there were three dozen units; for the second sheep, there were twenty-one hundred units. For the first ox, there were thirty-one hundred units; for the second ox, there were twenty-one hundred units.
verses.15: And twelve units for each brush; four brushes in total.
verses.16: And one of those “strong dogs” committed a sin; it was a sin against the eternal law. It was punished accordingly.
verses.17: And on the second day, there were twenty-two rams. Two of them were castrated. There were also fourteen young lambs.
verses.18: And from their offerings, they shall prepare sacrifices for the wild animals and for the birds, in accordance with the prescribed rules.
verses.19: And one of those “fierce dogs” committed a sin, both in relation to the everlasting ladder and its descent.
verses.20: And on the third day, there were twelve sheep. Two of them were castrated. There were also fourteen young animals.
verses.21: And their offerings and sacrifices were set aside for the sheep and cattle, in accordance with the law.
verses.22: And one sin will be punished along with the eternal punishment and its punishment.
verses.23: And on the fourth day, there were twelve sheep. Two of them were lambs. Fourteen of them were young animals.
verses.24: Their offerings and sacrifices were offered to the idols and to those who worship them, in accordance with the laws.
verses.25: And one of those wild dogs committed a sin, by climbing up from its resting place and then being sacrificed.
verses.26: And on the fifth day, there were nine sheep. Two of them were castrated. There were also fourteen young animals.
verses.27: And their offerings and sacrifices were set aside for the sheep and cattle, in accordance with the regulations.
verses.28: And one sin will be punished along with the eternal punishment and its aftermath.
verses.29: And on the sixth day, two sheep were slaughtered. They were fourteen young ones at that time.
verses.30: And from their sacrifices, they made offerings for the lambs and for the calves, according to their number, as commanded.
verses.31: And one sin will be punished, just as it was with the eternal punishment that came upon her.
verses.32: And on the seventh day, there were seventeen sheep. Two of them were castrated. There were also fourteen young lambs.
verses.33: And they were roasted in the fire, and their meat was distributed among the animals and birds, according to their number, as it was commanded.
verses.34: And one sin shall be forgiven, along with the eternal punishment that follows it.
verses.35: On the eighth day, you shall have no more any kind of work to do.
verses.36: And you brought along with you a woman who had the scent of incense for Jehovah. She brought one apple and one piece of bread, along with seven young pigeons that were fresh.
verses.37: Their offerings and sacrifices were offered to the gods, in accordance with their laws.
verses.38: And one sin shall be punished, along with the eternal punishment and its consequences.
verses.39: These things shall be done for Jehovah during your festivals, as part of your celebrations. They shall be used for your sacrifices, offerings, and meals.
